name: Backpack
description: A sturdy pack for carrying supplies.

name: Bedroll
description: A portable bedroll for sleeping while traveling.

name: Rations (1 day)
description: One day's supply of food.

name: Tinderbox
description: A small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder.

name: Waterskin
description: A leather container for water. Water quantity and consumption are not yet tracked.

name: Bell
description: A small hand bell.

name: Costume
description: A set of theatrical clothing.

name: Mirror
description: A small polished mirror.

name: Lamp
description: An oil lamp. Lighting and refueling interactions are not yet modeled.

name: Blanket
description: A warm blanket for travel.

name: Robe
description: A simple travel robe.

name: Alchemist's Fire (Flask)
description: A flask of sticky liquid that ignites on contact with air. Thrown: 1d4 fire damage and the target starts burning.

name: Hooded Lantern
description: A Hooded Lantern burns one flask of oil for 6 hours, casting Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

name: Crystal (Arcane Focus)
description: A crystal used to channel arcane spells. Can replace material components without a listed cost.

name: Orb (Arcane Focus)
description: A polished orb used to channel arcane spells. Can replace material components without a listed cost.

name: Rod (Arcane Focus)
description: A rod used to channel arcane spells. Can replace material components without a listed cost.

name: Staff (Arcane Focus)
description: A carved staff used to channel arcane spells. Can replace material components without a listed cost.

name: Wand (Arcane Focus)
description: A slender wand used to channel arcane spells. Can replace material components without a listed cost.

name: Healer's Kit
description: A leather pouch of bandages, salves, and splints with ten uses. Used to stabilize a dying creature without a Medicine check.

name: Acid (Vial)
description: A vial of corrosive acid. Thrown: 2d6 acid damage on a failed DEX save.

name: Antitoxin (Vial)
description: Drinking this grants Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition for 1 hour.

name: Basic Poison (Vial)
description: Coat a weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition; a hit deals an extra 1d4 poison damage.

name: Bullseye Lantern
description: A focused oil lantern casting a long beam. Provides light and +3 vision range for 10 turns.

name: Climber's Kit
description: Pitons, boot tips, gloves, and a harness. Useful for climbing and certain event skill checks.

name: Crowbar
description: An iron bar that grants leverage when forcing doors, crates, and lids.

name: Lute
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Wooden Staff (Druidic Focus)
description: A staff of living wood used to channel druidic spells.

name: Caltrops
description: A bag of spikes scattered to cover a 5-foot square; creatures entering it take 1 piercing damage and lose speed.

name: Oil (Flask)
description: A flask of lamp oil. Can be splashed and ignited for 5 fire damage, or used to refuel a lantern.

name: Gemstone (100 GP)
description: A fancy gemstone worth 100 gold.

name: Gemstone (10 GP)
description: A small ornamental gemstone worth 10 gold.

name: Gemstone (500 GP)
description: A precious gemstone worth 500 gold.

name: Crushed Black Pearl Powder (500+ GP)
description: The nonconsumed material component required to cast Circle of Death.

name: Gemstone (50 GP)
description: A semiprecious gemstone worth 50 gold.

name: Bagpipes
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Drum
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Dulcimer
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Flute
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Horn
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Lyre
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Pan Flute
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Shawm
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Viol
description: A musical instrument. Bards can use it as a spellcasting focus.

name: Mushroom Powder (25+ GP)
description: Consumed Material component for True Seeing.

name: Pearl (100+ GP)
description: A pearl worth at least 100 GP, used as a nonconsumed Material component for Identify.

name: Ashvale Brass Key
description: Opens the temple door and offering chest in the Ashvale antechamber.
